page.overview:
Who is Bar Mosquito?

The Bar Mosquito is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"Flik asks a mosquito at the bar if he knows any tough bugs, but the bug is too blasted to listen. "Hey bartender, Bloody Mary, O positive," he calls. One slurp and he's out cold. Flik won't get any help from him."

He is an alcoholic mosquito who was seen ordering a "Bloody Mary, O positive" from the bartender, and after he drank it, his body became large and then he passed out.
